arguments.step_name: Concerted E2 elimination RC -> products via TS1
arguments.reaction_coordinate_description: Concerted, strongly asynchronous elimination over a single saddle. Native IRC calc/irc3.log (calcfc, stepsize 5; normal termination; native both-directions convergence TRUE, 141 forward / 39 reverse points, endpoints -639.003407 Ha RC side and -639.022897 Ha product side) starts at exactly this TS geometry and connects the F-...H-CH2-CH2-Cl ion-dipole complex to C2H4 + HF + Cl-. Its reverse outer frame re-optimizes to the RC minimum (calc/endpoint_rev5.log, -639.003420924 Ha, 0 imaginary frequencies, identical to calc/rc2.log) and its forward outer frame to the product minimum (calc/endpoint_fwd5.log, -639.022951022 Ha, 0 imaginary frequencies, C2=C3 1.349 A, C3-Cl4 2.909 A, F1-H5 0.950 A); an independent repeat from the same two outer frames (calc/endpoint_rev6.log, calc/endpoint_fwd6.log) reproduces both minima to 0.0000 A. The imaginary mode (299.6i cm-1) is essentially pure proton transfer - H5 displacement 72.6%, heavy-atom fraction 0.058, C3-Cl4 projection 0.0045; at the saddle F1-H5 1.355 A, C2-H5 1.247 A, C3-Cl4 1.934 A, C2-C3 1.478 A - so the C-Cl bond is NOT part of the mode: it cleaves downhill after the saddle. Consequence, stated honestly: the step has no E2 barrier above the complex (dE(TS-RC) = +0.84 kcal/mol electronic; dE0 = -1.22 and dH(298) = -1.69 kcal/mol after ZPE/thermal correction) and the path is equally consistent with an E1cB-like continuum at this level of theory. Atom-mapping note: mapped SMILES [F-:1].[CH2:2]([H:4])[CH2:3][Cl:5] corresponds to log atom order F1, C2 = CH3 carbon, C3 = CH2Cl carbon, Cl4, H5, i.e. map H4 = log H5 and map Cl5 = log Cl4. Bond changes over the step: break C2-H4 and C3-Cl5, form F1-H4, C2-C3 order 1->2. NOTE: the harness short_irc machine check cannot bind this pair because its Gaussian IRC endpoint extractor returns filename=null for every Gaussian IRC log (Gaussian IRC jobs print only 'Input orientation' geometry blocks, never 'Standard orientation': 0 in irc3/irc4_fwd/irc4_rev vs 12-34 in the Opt/Freq logs), so it cannot materialise the rx<0/rx>0 outer frames; the supervisor independently verified the direction proof in these native files and a disposal of that stage was requested.
